mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPIAUCSL index signals rising inflation expectations, which elevates risk premiums and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises by >2% over 3 months, or the t-statistic for the regression of 20d returns on CPIAUCSL is >1.96 in absolute value.

mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate exceeds 4.0%, signaling aggressive monetary tightening, discount rates on equity cash flows rise, reducing future expected returns and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0%, or the 20d returns show no correlation with the FEDFUNDS crossing.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and falling UNRATE (lower unemployment) creates a robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings growth and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when both GDPC1 and UNRATE move in the predicted direction, or the interaction effect's p-value exceeds 0.05 in a regression analysis.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS rates signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and enhancing equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, the 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines, or the regime's expansion phase ends before the signal activates.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid growth in PAYEMS (labor employment) indicates strong labor market conditions, fostering economic momentum and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when PAYEMS rises by >2% in a month, or the correlation between PAYEMS and returns falls below 0.3.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trend in INDPRO (supply index) reflects increased production capacity, reducing inflationary pressures and supporting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO rises by >5% over 3 months, or the supply-demand imbalance ratio (INDPRO/CPIAUCSL) remains below 1.2.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.0%, signaling tight labor markets, it amplifies productivity gains and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 4.0%, or the unemployment rate's decline is not accompanied by a rise in 5d returns.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (industrial output) indicate robust demand-side growth, stimulating corporate investment and earnings, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST increase by >3% over the same period, or the interaction effect's p-value exceeds 0.05 in a regression analysis.
